segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Hi Gurpreet, hi Lakshmi, thanks for making time on a Friday.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: No problem. Fridays are calmer for us, the trucks go out early.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: I have Farhan with me, he'll handle the technical side of the onboarding.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: Hello everyone. I've gone through the notes from the demo, so I have some context.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: Good. Our main worry is the switch from spreadsheets. Finance lives in them.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Understood. Today I want to agree the go-live date, the scope for phase one, and who does what.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Let's start with scope then. We have two warehouses in Pune and the plant in Nashik.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: The plant has its own stock codes, right? Those would need a separate mapping.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Yes, Nashik uses older codes. It's a mess, honestly.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: Then I'd keep Nashik out of the first round. Let's get Pune working first.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: That's what we usually recommend. Gurpreet, are you okay with that?

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Yes. Phase one is only the two Pune warehouses, Nashik comes later.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Great, I'll note that down.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: For Pune I need your item list and opening stock. I'll send an import template for that.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: What format? Our system exports CSV.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: CSV is fine. The template just fixes the column order and units.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Farhan, when can they have it?

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: I'll send the data import template by Monday, with a short guide.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: Monday works. I'll block time next week to fill it.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Now, approvals. Right now purchase orders go through three people.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Could your system do a custom three-level approval flow for us?

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: It can be built, but it isn't part of the standard onboarding package.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: It would also add at least three weeks to the setup.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: I don't want to delay go-live for that. Two levels are enough to start.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Fine, let's park the three-level approval. We can raise it after go-live.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Noted as parked, not in scope for now.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: On the go-live date, we proposed 2 November in the demo.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: That is right after our month-end close. It's tight but doable.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: If the import template comes Monday, two weeks of data work should be enough.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: From our side the environment is ready, I set it up on Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: So we agree go-live for the Pune warehouses is 2 November?

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: Yes, 2 November. Let's commit to it.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Agreed.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: I'll also need the vendor master list, names, GST numbers and payment terms.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: That sits with purchase. Our team will pull the vendor list together by Friday.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: Make sure it's the cleaned list, not the one with duplicates from last year.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Yes, the cleaned one. And please remember the auditors are in on 28 October, so the week before that we're stretched.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Thanks for flagging the audit, we'll keep our asks light that week.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: What about the GST registration details for each warehouse? The invoices need them.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: I'll share the GST registration details for both Pune warehouses.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: Perfect, that's the last thing blocking invoice setup.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Then user logins. Who creates those on your side?

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Ramesh in our IT team handles that. He isn't on this call today.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Ramesh will create the user logins once Farhan shares the admin link.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: I'll send the admin link along with the template.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: How many users are we talking about? Licences are per user, yes?

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Per user, yes. Your contract covers twenty five.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: We'll need about eighteen for Pune. Nashik will take the rest later.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: Good, no extra cost then. That keeps my CFO happy.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: One more thing, training. We run two remote sessions before go-live.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet Sandhu
segments.text: Afternoons please, mornings are dispatch time.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Afternoons it is. I'll propose slots over email.

segments.speaker: Farhan Siddiqui
segments.text: From my side that's everything. I'll be the first contact for any data questions.

segments.speaker: Lakshmi Narayanan
segments.text: Thanks both. This was more organised than I expected.

segments.speaker: Pooja Menon
segments.text: Glad to hear it. Have a good weekend, everyone.

decisions.fact: Phase one covers only the two Pune warehouses; the Nashik plant follows later.
Go-live for the Pune warehouses is fixed for 2 November.

action_items.fact: Farhan sends the data import template with a short guide.
The client's purchase team compiles the cleaned vendor master list; no person named.
Lakshmi shares the GST registration details for both Pune warehouses.
Ramesh (client IT, not on the call) creates the user logins.

distractors.fact: A custom three-level approval flow was requested and parked.
28 October is the client's audit, not the vendor list's deadline.
